'''2013 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Olaf Schroeder LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Olaf Schroeder]] at [[2013 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Joe Freedom
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
